constructions.title: Counts over the four ODA extracts

*.rows_read.is: Rows of the extract with as many fields as its header; rows shorter than the header are counted apart.

*.short_rows.is: Rows shorter than the header: fragments of a broken note field, read no further.

*.years.*.is: The earliest and latest year among the rows' dates, as the first four characters of the date field.

kemi.parameters.is: Distinct values of `Parameter` among the full rows of the kemi extract.

kemi.parameters_multi_unit.is: Parameters whose rows carry more than one distinct non-blank `Enhed`.

kemi.units.*.*.is: Rows of one parameter with one value of `Enhed`, for the parameters that carry more than one.

kemi.negative_results.is: Rows whose `Resultat` parses as a number below zero.

kemi.nutrient_rows.is: Rows of the parameters listed in `nutrient_parameters`: nutrients, TOC and POC under the extract's names.

kemi.nutrient_rows_censored_lt.is: Of those, the rows whose `ResultatAttribut` is `<`.

kemi.depth_exactly_99.is: Rows whose `GennemsnitsDybde_m` parses as exactly the round value the page names.

kemi.integrated.is: Rows whose sample type is `Dybdeintegreret prøve`.

kemi.integrated_shallow.is: Of those, the rows whose `GennemsnitsDybde_m` is no deeper than the shallow threshold stored beside it.

kemi.shallow_threshold_m.is: A nominal depth this shallow enters a surface filter; chosen, not measured.

kemi.saturation_rows.is: Rows of `Oxygenmætning` with a numeric result.

kemi.saturation_max_pct.is: The largest `Oxygenmætning` result in the kemi extract, as recorded.

ctd.rows_with_all_three.is: Rows where `KorrektionsFaktor`, `OriginalResultat` and `KorrigeretResultat` all parse as numbers.

ctd.rows_where_product_holds.is: Of those, rows where the corrected result equals the original times the factor, to within half a unit of the corrected value's last stored decimal.

ctd.factor_band.*.is: The band inside which a correction factor counts as an adjustment rather than a conversion; chosen, not measured.

ctd.by_parameter.*.with_factor.is: Of those, rows with a numeric `KorrektionsFaktor`.

ctd.by_parameter.*.factor_not_1.is: Rows whose factor is not exactly one.

ctd.by_parameter.*.outside_band.is: Rows whose factor lies outside the stored band.

ctd.by_parameter.*.max_factor.is: The largest factor recorded for that parameter.

lys.light_threshold_pct.is: A share of surface light above which a reading is not reading noise; chosen, not measured.

lys.light_above_threshold.is: Rows whose `Lysprocent` is above the stored threshold.

lys.yintercept_9999999.is: Rows whose `YIntercept` parses as the sentinel value the migration note names.

maaledybde.secchi_to_bottom.is: Rows whose `SigtTilBund` is `True`: the disc reached the bottom.

maaledybde.deepest_stations.*.max_m.is: The largest `BundDybde_m` recorded at one station.

maaledybde.deepest_stations.*.median_m.is: The median of that station's `BundDybde_m` readings.

maaledybde.deepest_stations.*.readings.is: That station's rows with a numeric `BundDybde_m`.

maaledybde.hirtshals_15m.max_m.is: The largest `BundDybde_m` at the station named `Hirtshals 15 m`.

maaledybde.hirtshals_15m.median_m.is: The median of that station's `BundDybde_m` readings.

maaledybde.hirtshals_15m.readings.is: That station's rows with a numeric `BundDybde_m`.

kemi.not_detected_by_parameter.*.is: Rows per parameter whose `ResultatAttribut` is `ikke påvist`: analysed, and nothing found.

lys.yintercept_note_rows.is: Rows whose light-attenuation note says the intercept was set to the sentinel value.

lys.yintercept_note_blank_rows.is: Of those, rows whose `YIntercept` is blank.

constructions.what: Counts and extremes over every row of the kemi, ctd, lys and maaledybde extracts, for the warnings on DATA_SOURCES.md.
constructions.model: `scripts/ds_facts.py` streams each gzipped extract with the csv module, decoded as `latin-1` with a semicolon delimiter, and parses numbers with `formats.num`, which reads the decimal comma. A row with fewer fields than the header is counted as short and skipped. Counters are kept per parameter, unit and station; thresholds are module constants written into the output beside the counts they define.
assumptions: A row with as many fields as the header is a genuine row.
The thresholds are choices; a different choice gives a different count, not a wrong one.

justified.text: Every row of every extract is read; nothing is sampled, so a rare value cannot be missed.
Numbers are parsed by the one declared parser for ODA, so a decimal comma cannot empty a column.

gaps: The product check allows half a unit of the corrected value's last stored decimal; a factor applied and then rounded differently would count as a mismatch.
void_if: an extract is refetched and the script is not rerun
constructions.licenses: How often each trap occurs in the extracts as downloaded.
constructions.not_licensed: Which of the flagged rows are errors: the counts say where a value is unusual, not that it is wrong.

constructions.title: What each service answered, and when

*.status.is: The HTTP status the service returned to an anonymous request on the stored date.

*.layers.is: Feature types listed in the WFS server's GetCapabilities response to an anonymous request.

constructions.what: The answers of the services DATA_SOURCES.md describes, to one anonymous request each.
constructions.model: `scripts/ds_probe.py` sends one GET with the project's user agent to each URL and stores the status, or the error when there is none; for the two WFS servers it counts the FeatureType elements of the capabilities document. Host resolution is tested with the system resolver.
assumptions: One request on one day stands for how the service answers; a service can answer differently to another client or on another day.

justified.text: The request and its answer are stored with the date, so the page states an observation it can show.

gaps: A service that answers differently to a browser than to a script is recorded as it answered the script.
void_if: the probe is older than the claim resting on it needs
constructions.licenses: That on the stored date the service answered this, anonymously.
constructions.not_licensed: That it answers so today, or to every client.
